title: Boutique Catering Lead Recovery Desk
oneLiner: A hospitality sales workspace that rescues high-intent catering inquiries by exposing quote delays, menu indecision, and venue coordination blockers before leads go cold.
targetUser: Boutique catering owners, event sales managers, and hospitality coordinators handling inbound event leads.
keyUX: Review at-risk event leads, inspect where the booking conversation stalled, and send the right follow-up package from one elegant workflow.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop hospitality sales workspace called Boutique Catering Lead Recovery Desk for boutique catering owners and event sales managers. It should help teams recover high-intent event inquiries by combining lead value, quote turnaround, menu selection friction, venue coordination blockers, and polished follow-up actions in one premium interface. Include lead rescue headline metrics, an at-risk event inquiry list, a quote turnaround tracker, a menu and venue blocker panel, a client conversation timeline, and a follow-up package composer. Design direction: use a premium-editorial aesthetic with refined typography, generous spacing, warm neutrals, charcoal contrast, and subtle luxury cues so the product feels high-touch, composed, and service-oriented.
